coach.title: Coach
coach.leaveMessage: {{name}} will no longer see your workouts, programs or set videos. The prescriptions and programs {{name}} gave you are removed.
coach.requestBody: {{name}} will see your workouts, the programs you follow and your set videos, and can assign programs, prescribe workouts and leave notes.
coach.declineMessage: {{name}} won't see anything. They can ask again later.
coach.leaveFirst: You can have one coach at a time. Leave {{coach}} before you accept {{name}}.
coach.coachSees: {{name}} sees your workouts, the programs you follow and your set videos.
coach.pastBody: Your coaching with {{name}} ended on {{date}}. The conversation stays here for you.

coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.noClientsHint: Tap Add to ask someone to be your client. They accept or decline, and you see nothing of theirs until they accept.
coaching.needsConnection: This needs a connection. Try again once you're back online.

errors.leaveFirst: Leave your coach before you accept another.
errors.statusChanged: This request has been answered or ended in the meantime.

requests.title: Requests
requests.cancelMessage: {{name}} will no longer see it. You can ask again later.

request.title: Add client
request.intro: Choose who to coach. They get a request to accept or decline, and you see nothing of theirs until they accept.
request.notePlaceholder: Say hello or why you're reaching out

end.title: End coaching with {{name}}?
end.message: {{name}} will no longer be your client. You'll stop seeing their workouts, and the prescriptions and programs you gave them are removed.

assign.title: Assign a program
assign.hint: Pick one of your programs to assign to {{name}}.
assign.noPrograms: Create a program first to assign one.
assign.makeActiveHint: Off = added to their library; they can switch to it themselves later

prescriptions.title: Prescribed workouts
prescriptions.removeMessage: Your client will no longer see this prescription in their diary.

prescribe.title: Prescribe a workout
prescribe.hint: Pick a workout template and optionally a date. If no date is set, your client can start it whenever.
prescribe.noTemplates: Create a program with workouts first to prescribe.

editPrescription.title: Edit prescription
editPrescription.hint: Update the date or add notes. Leave the date empty for an anytime prescription your client can do on their own schedule.

recent.title: Recent workouts
recent.replied: Your client replied to your note

workout.title: Workout
workout.addWorkoutNote: Add a note on this workout
workout.addExerciseNote: Add a note on this exercise
workout.notePlaceholder: Form, intensity, what to push next…
workout.deleteWorkoutNote: Your workout-level feedback for this session will be removed.
workout.deleteExerciseNote: Your note on this exercise will be removed.

video.title: Set video
video.label: Set video: {{exercise}}
video.playbackFailed: That clip could not be played.
video.markHere: Note at {{time}}: stamp it where the video is paused

coaching.badgeAria: Coaching has something waiting for you

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.label: Conversation with {{name}}
conversation.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to {{name}}.
conversation.closed: This coaching has ended. The conversation can be read but not added to.
conversation.photoGone: This photo is no longer available
conversation.tooLong: A message can be up to {{max}} characters.
conversation.deleteMessage: {{name}} will see “Message deleted” in its place.
conversation.offline: You're offline. Messages you write now are sent when you're back online. They are kept only while this page stays open.
